title: 2026 IS YOUR YEAR OF VICTORY AND TESTIMONY
text: Beloved, before we go into the depths of what the spirit of God is saying concerning this season, I want you to do something for me. I want you to share this word with someone. Don't just keep it to yourself. There is somebody in your contact list. There is somebody in your sphere of influence that needs to hear what God is about to release. The Bible says in Psalm 68 to11, "The Lord gave the word, great was the company of those that published it." When you share the word, you become a publisher of divine truth. And as you publish it, that same anointing that brings victory begins to work in your own life. So right now, share this message. Send it to that brother. Send it to that sister. Send it to that family member who has been going through battles. Tell them this is your year of victory and testimony. As you do that, you are activating something in the realm of the spirit. Now I want you to lift up your hands wherever you are. Whether you are watching this in your room, in your car, in your office, I want you to lift up your hands right now because we are about to engage heaven. There are some things that will not happen by casual observation. There are dimensions of glory that require engagement. The Bible says in James 4:8, "Draw nigh to God and he will draw nigh to you." So right now, position yourself. I don't care what you've been through in 2025. I don't care how many battles you fought. I don't care how many disappointments attempted to crush your spirit. The word of the Lord for you is clear. 2026 is your year of victory and testimony. Let me tell you something about the nature of God. Our God is not a God of defeat. Our God is not a God of failure. Our God is not a God of shame. The Bible says in 2 Corinthians 2:14, "Now thanks be unto God, which always caus us [music] to triumph in Christ." Did you see that word always? Not sometimes. Not when the circumstances are favorable, not when everything is lined up perfectly. Always. That means that irrespective of what the enemy has arranged against you, irrespective of what the circumstances are declaring, irrespective of what your bank account is saying, irrespective of what the medical report is saying, God has already concluded that you will triumph. Now I need you to understand something about divine timing. There are seasons in the kingdom and every season carries a specific grace. When Jesus began his ministry, the Bible says in Mark 1:15, the time is fulfilled and the kingdom of God is at hand. That word time in the Greek is chyros. It speaks of an appointed time, a strategic time, a time that carries unusual opportunity. 2026 is your chairos moment. It is your appointed time for victory. It is your strategic season for testimony. Some of you have been in battles for so long that you have began to accommodate defeat. You have began to normalize delay. You have began to accept limitation as your portion. But I have come to announce to you by the authority of the word of God that your season has changed. The Bible says in Ecclesiastes 3:1, to everything there is a season and a time to every purpose under the heaven. Your time has come. Your season has arrived. This is not the time for you to be timid. This is not the time for you to be apologetic about your faith. This is the time for you to be violent in the realm of the spirit. Jesus said in Matthew 11:12, "From the days of John the Baptist until now, the kingdom of heaven suffered violence and the violent take it by force." There is a kind of faith that is casual and there is a kind of faith that is militant. Casual faith hopes things will work out. Militant faith declares that things must work out. Casual faith prays, "Lord, if it be your will." Militant faith prays, "Lord, your word has declared it. Therefore, it is settled." Some of you need to transition from casual faith to militant faith. You need to stop being a spectator in your own life and become a warrior in the realm of the spirit. Now, let me show you something powerful in scripture. In 2 Kings chapter 7, there were four lepros men at the entering in of the gate during a time of severe famine in Samaria. The city was under siege and people were dying of hunger. These four men were in the worst possible condition. They were lepers, outcasts, and they were starving. But something happened. They had a conversation. They said to themselves, "Why sit we here until we die? If we say we will enter into the city, then the famine is in the city, and we shall die there. And if we sit still here, we die also." Now therefore, come and let us fall onto the host of the Syrians. If they save us alive, we shall live, and if they kill us, we shall but die. Do you see what happened? They made a decision. They refused to remain in a place of defeat. They refused to accept their current reality as their final reality. And when they rose up and went to the camp of the Syrians, the Bible says that God caused the Syrians to hear the noise of chariots and the noise of horses. The entire Syrian army fled, leaving behind their tents, their food, their gold, their silver, their possessions. And those four lepros [music] men became the first to testify of the supernatural turnaround that came to Samaria. That is your story in 2026. You may be surrounded by circumstances that look impossible. You may be in a situation where every option seems to lead to death. But I prophesy to you that when you rise up with a madeup mind, when you refuse to sit in the place of defeat, God will cause confusion in the camp of your enemies. Every system that has been militating against you will collapse. Every network that has been working against your progress will disintegrate and you will be the first to testify of the goodness of God. Lift up your voice right now and say, "Father, I thank you because 2026 is my year of victory and testimony. Every siege against my life is [music] broken. Every limitation is shattered. Every delay is canceled in the mighty name of Jesus. You see, the enemy understands the power of testimony. That is why he fights so hard to keep God's people in secret struggles. He doesn't want your breakthrough to become public. He doesn't want your healing to [music] become a testimony. He doesn't want your restoration to become a declaration of God's power. But I have news for you. The Bible says in Revelation 12:11, "And they overcame him by the blood of the lamb and by the word of their testimony." Your testimony is a weapon. Your testimony is not just for you. It is for the encouragement of others. It is to silence the voice of the enemy. It is to bring glory to God. Some of you have been through battles that you have never told anyone about. You have been through midnight seasons where you wept until you had no more tears. You have been through financial pressures that threatened to break you. You have been through health challenges that made you question whether you would make it. But you are still here. You are still standing. You are still believing. And I prophesy to you that in 2026 that secret struggle will become a public testimony. What the enemy meant to use to destroy you, God will use as a platform to display his power. Now, let me take you to the book of Exodus. When God was about to deliver the children of Israel from Egypt, Pharaoh resisted. He didn't want to let them go. And the more Moses demanded their release, the harder Pharaoh's heart became. But God told Moses something profound in Exodus 14:13:14. Fear ye not. Stand still and see the salvation of the Lord, which he will show to you today. For the Egyptians whom ye have seen today, ye shall see them again no more forever. The Lord shall fight for you, and ye shall hold your peace. Did you hear that? The Lord shall fight for you. [music] Not you fighting for yourself. Not you struggling in your own strength. Not you manipulating circumstances. God himself will fight for you. And when God fights, defeat is impossible. When God fights, failure is not an option. When God fights, victory is guaranteed. So I speak to you right now. Every battle that has refused to bow, every problem that has refused to move, every situation that has refused to change, the Lord himself will fight for you in 2026. And notice what God said. The Egyptians whom ye have seen today, ye shall see them again no more forever. Some of you have been seeing the same problems year after year. the same financial struggles, the same health issues, the same relationship conflicts, the same career limitations, but God is saying this is the last time you will see this problem in 2026. God will grant you permanent victory over persistent battles. Shout right now and say, "Permanent victory is my portion. I will not see this problem again. It ends in 2026." You know, there is something I want you to understand about the character of God. Our God is a God of suddenly. He's a God of unexpected turnarounds. He's a God who specializes in doing the impossible at the last minute. The Bible is full of suddenly moments. In Acts 2:2, the Bible says, "And suddenly there came a sound from heaven as of a rushing mighty wind." In Acts 16-26, when Paul and Silas were in prison, the Bible says, "And suddenly there was a great earthquake so that the foundations of the prison were shaken and immediately all the doors were opened [music] and everyone's bands were loosed." God is about to visit you with a suddenly moment. Just when you thought it was over, suddenly just when you thought it was impossible, suddenly. Just when the enemy thought he had won, suddenly I decree and declare that 2026 will be characterized by divine suddenly moments in your life. Suddenly that door will open. Suddenly that miracle will manifest. Suddenly that breakthrough will come. Suddenly that testimony will be born. Now I want to pray with you. But before I pray, I need you to understand the posture of prayer. Prayer is not begging God. Prayer is enforcing the victory that Jesus already won on the cross. When Jesus said on the cross, "It is finished." He was declaring that every battle has already been won. Every curse has already been broken. Every limitation has already been removed. Every enemy has already been defeated. So when we pray, we are not trying to convince [music] God to do something new. We are aligning ourselves with what he has already done. Lift up your hands right now and pray with me. Father, I come before your throne of grace with boldness. I thank you because you are the God of victory. You are the God of testimony. You are the God who causes me to triumph always in Christ Jesus. I declare that 2026 is my year of victory and testimony. Every battle that I carried from previous years, I command it to bow right now in the name of Jesus. Every limitation that has been following my family lineage, I break it right now by the power in the blood of Jesus. Every cycle of defeat, I command it to stop right now in the name of Jesus. I decree that every door that the enemy has shut against me will be opened by force in 2026. I decree that every opportunity that passed me by in previous years will locate me in this season. I decree that every good thing that was stolen from me will be restored sevenfold in the name of Jesus. I am not a victim. I am a victor. I am not defeated. I am triumphant. I am not struggling. I am reigning in life through Christ Jesus. Every satanic resistance against my progress, I command you to seize right now in the name of Jesus. Every demonic conspiracy against my destiny, I abort you right now by the authority of the word of God. Every evil gathering against my breakthrough, I scatter you right now by fire in the name of Jesus. I am not a candidate for defeat. I am a candidate for victory. I am not a candidate for shame. I am a candidate for glory. I am not a candidate for failure. I am a candidate [music] for success. In 2026, I will excel in my career. In 2026, I will prosper in my business. In 2026, I [music] will be healed in my body. In 2026, I will experience breakthrough in my finances. In 2026, I will be celebrated. In 2026, I will be a testimony. This is my year of victory and testimony in the mighty name of Jesus. Now shout the loudest hallelujah you have ever shouted. Let me tell you something about the power of confession. The Bible says in Proverbs 18:21, "Death and life are in the power of the tongue, and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof." Your words are not just sounds. Your words are seeds. Your words are creative forces. When you speak the word of God over your life, you are activating heavenly realities in the earthly realm. That is why the enemy fights so hard to get you to speak negatively. He wants you to prophesy your own defeat. He wants you to declare your own limitations, but you must refuse to cooperate with him. I want you to make a decision right now that in 2026, you will only speak words of victory. You will only speak words of faith. You will only speak words of testimony. Stop saying, "I'm trying." Start saying, "I'm triumphing." Stop saying, "It's difficult." Start saying all things are possible. Stop saying I don't know how it will happen. [music] Start saying God will make a way where there seems to be no way. Your confession determines your possession. What you say is what you see. Let me show you something. In the book of Numbers chapter 13, when the children of Israel sent 12 spies to go and spy out the land of Canaan, 10 of them came back with a negative report. They said, "We saw giants in the land, and we were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight." But Caleb had a different report. He said, "Let us go up at once and possess it, for we are well able to overcome it." Same land, same giants, different confession, different outcome. The 10 who spoke defeat died in the wilderness, but Caleb and Joshua entered the promised land. What are you saying about your situation? Are you speaking like the 10 or are you speaking like Caleb? Are you declaring defeat or are you declaring victory? I challenge you today, change your confession. Stop magnifying your problems and start magnifying your God. Stop talking about how big the giant is and start talking about how big your God is. Stop saying it's too hard and start saying my God is able. Somebody needs to declare right now, I am well able. I will possess my possession. 2026 is my year of victory and testimony. Now I want to address something that many believers struggle with the issue of delay. Some of you have been waiting for breakthrough for so long that you have began to lose hope. You prayed in 2020 and nothing happened. You believed in 2021 and nothing changed. You fasted in 2022 and the situation remained the same. You decreed in 2023 and the door stayed closed. You prophesied in 2024 and the miracle didn't manifest. You stood in faith in 2025 and you are still waiting. And now you're wondering, will 2026 be any different? Let me tell you what the Bible says in Habacook 2 3. For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak and not lie. Though it tar, wait for it because it will surely come. It will not t. Did you see that? Though it t it will surely come. Delay is not denial. God's timing is not your timing. But God's timing is always [music] perfect. What you perceive as delay is actually divine preparation. God is setting up something so magnificent, so glorious, so overwhelming that when it manifests, you will understand why you [music] had to wait. Think about Abraham. God promised him a son, but he had to wait 25 years. Think about Joseph. He had a dream, but he had to wait 13 years. Think about David. He was anointed king, but he had to wait 15 years. Think about Jesus himself. There was a 400 years silence between the Old Testament and the New Testament. But when Jesus showed up, the entire world was transformed. Your breakthrough may have been delayed, but I prophesy to you that when it comes in 2026, it will be worth the wait. Shout right now and say, "My breakthrough is coming. My testimony is coming. Is worth the wait." Let me pray for you again because there are some things that need to be enforced through prayer. Father, I come against every spirit of delay in the life of your son, your daughter who is watching this right now. I command every demonic hold up to be released right now in the name of Jesus. Every satanic embodings, I break it right now by the [music] authority in the name of Jesus. Every evil covenant that has been delaying their breakthrough, I nullify it right now by the blood of Jesus. Every ancestral pattern of delay, I break it right now by fire in [music] the name of Jesus. I decree that what should have happened years ago will happen suddenly in 2026. I decree accelerated breakthrough. I decree supernatural speed. I decree divine acceleration. The Bible says in Isaiah 60-22, "A little one shall become a thousand and a small one a strong nation. I the Lord will hasten it in his time. Father, hasten their breakthrough, hasten their testimony, hasten their victory. What would ordinarily take 10 years, let it happen in one year. What would ordinarily take 5 years, let it happen in one month. What would ordinarily take one year, let it happen in one day. I speak to every closed door, be opened right now in the name of Jesus. I speak to every blocked opportunity be released right now in the name of Jesus. I speak to every delayed miracle manifest right now in the name of Jesus. 2026 is your year of victory and testimony. It is settled in heaven. It is decreed on earth. It is done in the name of Jesus. Can I get a loud amen? You see, there is something about the power of persistence. The Bible tells us in Luke 18 about the parable of the persistent widow. She kept coming to the unjust judge demanding justice. And the judge, though he feared neither God nor man, eventually gave her justice because of her persistence. And Jesus said, "Hear what the unjust judge saith. And shall not God avenge his own elect which cried day and night unto him, though he bear long with them. I tell you that he will avenge them speedily." Some of you have been praying for the same thing for years. And the enemy has been whispering, "Give up. It's not going to happen. God has forgotten about you." But I want to tell you today, don't stop now. You are closer than you think. Your breakthrough is at the door. Your testimony is about to be born. This is not the time to quit. This is not the time to give up. This is not the time to surrender. This is the time to press harder. This is the time to pray louder. This is the time to believe bigger. The Bible says in Galatians 6:9, "And let us not be weary in welloing, for in due season we shall reap if we faint not." If we faint not, that means your reaping is conditional on your not fainting. Your harvest is conditional on your not giving [music] up. Your testimony is conditional on your not quitting. So I command your spirit right now, do not faint. Do not give up. Do not quit. Your due season has come. 2026 is your year of victory and testimony. I want you to understand something about the nature of spiritual warfare. The enemy doesn't fight you because you are weak. He fights you because you are dangerous. He doesn't attack you because you are insignificant. He attacks you because you carry a destiny that threatens his kingdom. Every battle you are facing is a confirmation that you are on the right path. Every attack you are experiencing is proof that you carry something precious. The enemy doesn't waste his time on people who are not a threat to him. So when you face resistance, don't be discouraged. Be encouraged. It means you are close to your breakthrough. It means you are about to enter a new dimension. It means something glorious is about to happen. The devil knows that if you break through, you will be unstoppable. That's why he fights so hard. But I have news for him. He has already lost. The battle is already won. 2026 is your year of victory and testimony. And there is nothing he can do about it. Declare right now, devil, you have lost. I am victorious. I am triumphant. 2026 is my year. Let me take you to Psalm 30 to 5. The Bible says, "Weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning." Some of you have been in a night season. It has been dark. It has been difficult. It has been discouraging. But I announce to you that your morning has come. Your night is over. Your weeping [music] is finished. Joy is coming. Laughter is coming. Celebration is coming. Testimony is coming. Victory is coming. And it's coming in 2026. I see you celebrating. I see you testifying. I see you dancing. I see you rejoicing. I see you sharing your testimony of how God turned your situation around. I see you telling people it was God. It was his grace. It was his mercy. It was his faithfulness. I see you becoming a living epistle, a walking testimony, a demonstration of the power of God. This is your year. This is your season. This is your time. Now, I want to pray a prayer of declaration over your life. I want you to receive this prayer by faith. I want you to let these words go deep into your spirit. I want you to believe that what I am declaring is already done in [music] the realm of the spirit. And it is only a matter of time before it manifests in the natural realm. Father, I stand in the gap for your son, your daughter who is receiving this word right now. I declare by the authority of your word that 2026 is their year of victory and testimony. I decree that every plan [music] of the enemy against their life is aborted right now in the name of Jesus. I decree that every evil imagination against their destiny is canceled right now in the name of Jesus. I decree that every satanic prediction against their future is nullified right now in the name of Jesus. I release the spirit of victory upon their life right now. I release the spirit of breakthrough upon their circumstances right now. I release the spirit of testimony upon their situation right now. From this moment forward, they will begin to experience unusual favor. Doors that were closed will begin to open. Opportunities that were blocked will begin to flow. Miracles that were delayed will begin to manifest. Breakthroughs that were resisted will begin to happen. I decree that in 2026, they will testify in their finances. They will testify in their health. They will testify in their relationships. They will testify in their career. They will testify in their ministry. They will testify in their family. They will testify in every area of their life. They are not a candidate for defeat. They are a candidate for victory. They are not a candidate for shame. They are a candidate for honor. They are not a candidate for failure. They are a candidate for success. Every demonic opposition be removed right now in the name of Jesus. Every satanic resistance be destroyed right now in the name of Jesus. every evil force be paralyzed right now in the name of Jesus. I cover them with the blood of Jesus. I surround them with the fire of God. I commission angels to go ahead of them and prepare the way for their breakthrough. It is done. It is settled. It is finished in the mighty name of Jesus. Now, lift up your voice and thank God [music] for your victory. Begin to praise him for your testimony. Begin to worship him for your breakthrough. Don't wait until you see it to praise him. Praise him now. Thank him now. Celebrate him now. Your praise is an expression of your faith. Your thanksgiving is a demonstration of your confidence in God. When you praise God before the manifestation, you are telling the enemy that you know the [music] battle is already won. Some of you have been so focused on the problem that you have forgotten to praise God. You have been so consumed with the battle that you have forgotten to worship. But I want to remind you, God inhabits the praises of his people. When you praise him, his presence comes. And where his presence is, chains are broken, captives are delivered, miracles happen, and testimonies are born. So I command you to shift your focus from the problem to the problem solver. Shift your attention from the battle to the battle winner. Shift your gaze from the circumstance to the circumstance changer. Shout to the Lord right now. Praise him with everything in you. Thank him for your victory. Celebrate him for your testimony. I want to close with this word from Romans 8:37. Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us. Did you see that? More than conquerors. Not just conquerors, more than conquerors. That means you don't just win the battle, you win with overwhelming victory. You don't just survive, you thrive. You don't just overcome, you dominate. You don't just make it through, you triumph gloriously. That is who you are in 2026. You are more than a conqueror. You are not struggling through this year. You are reigning in this year. You are not barely making it. You are excelling beyond measure. You are not hoping things will work out. You are declaring that things [music] are already working out. This is your year of victory and testimony. I decree it. I declare it. I prophesy it. I release it. 2026 is your year of victory and testimony in the mighty name of Jesus. Every person who hears this word, receive it by faith. Walk in it with confidence. Live it with boldness. And when your testimony manifests and it will manifest, don't forget to give God all the glory. Don't forget to share your testimony. Don't forget to encourage someone else who is still believing for their breakthrough. You are victorious. You are triumphant. You are blessed. You are favored. [music] You are anointed. You are empowered. You are destined for greatness. 2026 is your year of victory and testimony. It is settled. It is done. It is finished in the mighty name of Jesus. Amen on Amen.
